original_card.question: What exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained?
methods: Compare exact heads and retained artifacts to write a source-bound disposition receipt.
Audit an existing receipt for missing content or predecessor attribution.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Separate complete integration, partial retention and changed heads; make no autonomous closures.

first_step.inspect: Read one small PR set in the ledger and identify exact reviewed heads and unresolved content.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Compare that set to retained artifacts; produce a complete or explicitly partial disposition receipt.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material.
allowed_variations: One small related PR family or one existing integration receipt.
scope_change_triggers: Treating matching titles or one shared blob as proof of full incorporation.

actual_scope: Overlap receipt for one small named PR set: the seven fourth100 reconciliation entries (#636, #638, #639, #640, #642, #644, #646) whose contributed-package replay fails at verify.py line 39 with 'AssertionError: larger_gain manifest pin'. At each recorded head: the source-pin block checked against exact committed bytes, every changed path's byte-retention in main at the base commit, and predecessor credit.
scope_change_reason: The card's question and method are unchanged; the concrete set is the small family whose ledger unresolved question is one shared, precisely recorded failure, and whose audited receipt is the fourth100 reconciliation. A distinct set from the concurrent selected-replay-tooling receipt claim and the PR99->PR103 retention claim.
bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap evidence preserves credit and prevents repeated review of already-retained material: this receipt separates the re-vendored predecessor content (280-285 of each vectorsss PR's changed paths are already byte-retained in main) from the genuinely new witness content, and diagnoses the one pin defect that blocked all seven replays, so a reviewer need not repeat the failed replay to see what is actually new.
stop_rule: One bounded receipt: pin block + retention census + credit for the seven recorded heads; no full contributed replay, no disposition changes; stop at the session's verification quarter.
evidence: RECEIPT.json plus evidence/pr{N}-audit.json (per-PR pin tables and changed-path rows) and evidence/larger-gain-MANIFEST.{pr569-rev,main-staged}.json; offline checker verify.py with one positive fixture and four failure controls. Finding: all seven recorded failures share one cause, a larger_gain MANIFEST pin (PR569 revision 897213a, sha256 54d67f45...) that does not match the manifest as staged into main by df417acd (sha256 73c186c2...), differing in exactly the NOTICE and README.md entries; the six vectorsss packages vendor the pinned revision byte-exactly while #646 resolves the drifted live package.
author: Aaron Wang / navinor
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance: prepared with help from opencode. No independent human review claimed.

open_questions.question: What source resolution did the fourth100 harness pass to these verify.py files, given that the six vectorsss packages pass their pin block through their own verify.sh overrides?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If the harness simply resolved sources to live packages, the six ledger questions are re-run conditions, not content defects, and their replays can proceed past the pin block.
open_questions.first_step: Run #636's verify.sh pin block (--check-pins) in a byte-preserving checkout of recorded head 679621828a85bac68af869fb0e55b54508e6b14b and confirm PINS OK.
open_questions.blocked_by: The recorded traceback stops at the assertion and does not record the harness's source resolution; the fourth100 harness extraction is not reproduced by any committed artifact.

open_questions.question: Should main reconcile the larger_gain pin drift (vendor the pinned PR569 revision or re-pin to the df417acd-staged manifest)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Until then every replay that resolves larger_gain to the live research/larger-gain package fails at the same pin, and #646 cannot pass its pin block at all.
open_questions.first_step: Confirm with maintainers that df417acd's NOTICE/README.md rewrite of research/larger-gain was intentional, then either re-pin the seven SPECs or restore the pinned revision.
open_questions.blocked_by: Maintainer decision on pin policy; this receipt deliberately changes no pin.

open_questions.question: Which of the 57-109 unretained paths per PR is method code worth retaining versus generated witness output?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Retention of method code preserves reuse and credit; generated outputs do not need retention.
open_questions.first_step: Classify the not_retained path lists in evidence/pr{N}-audit.json by extension and directory (bounded, offline).
